title: Q9
description:
“So we see that they could not enter in because of unbelief.”
Read: Num 14:11, Heb 4:2
a) Yahweh asked, “How long will they not believe Me, with all the signs which I have performed among them?” What does that bring forward: is unbelief ignorance, or refusal of what has been seen and heard (compare 4:2: “the word which they heard did not profit them, not being mixed with faith”)?
